title: Run of the loop fuel machine
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $c$ be a configuration of $F$ on $x$, and let $t$ be a natural number. Running the loop fuel source machine for $t$ steps from the loop fuel configuration built from $c$ yields the loop fuel configuration built from the configuration reached by running $F$ for $t$ steps from $c$.
